title: Configuration
phoneHint: Phone: join open WiFi microPhotoFrame (2.4 GHz), turn off mobile data, then http://192.168.4.1 — not the home WiFi.
scanReady: Page ready. WiFi list loads in the background…
serverUrlHint: Host and port only, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:888
orientMpu: With a built-in sensor the pose is detected automatically; this value applies only without a sensor.
orientNoMpu: This device has no pose sensor. The chosen orientation is fixed.
deepSleep: Deep Sleep between images. Off by default on NeoFrame: power banks cut power when current is low. Enable only with a wall supply.
deepSleepWs: Deep Sleep between images. On by default on this board (own power/charge circuit).
scanFail: Scan failed. Enter the SSID manually below.
noGroupsHint: No Group ID for this User ID and display.
groupsNetFail: Groups failed. The device must reach the home network.
needSsid: Please choose a WiFi network or enter the SSID.
needGroup: Please load and choose a Group ID.
savedBody: The device restarts and connects to WiFi…
missingParams: Missing fields: SSID, server URL, User ID and Group ID are required.
